The '''Numatra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Southern Core]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[numatra]]s,<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> as well as the origin point of [[Numatra snakehide]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /><ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Numatra system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-12.<ref name="TEA" />
